verdict.rationale: CAM's own pages say it represents venture capital and private equity funds through its PE and Investment Funds practices, and that it advises start-ups, so it plausibly sits on both sides of the table. However, the evidence never shows that this dual-sided work translates into documented knowledge of current venture market terms. missing for 10: evidence of current market-terms expertise (e.g., term-sheet trend reports or deal-term surveys), venture-financing deal examples showing investor-side and company-side representation, independent corroboration (rankings or client reviews) of venture-terms knowledge.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table
